summary: iter95v (Wyceny Excel import: preview + apply) - Backend FULLY VERIFIED via pytest (13/13 passed). All endpoints behave per spec: POST /api/wyceny/import/preview parses XLSX, supports data-URI prefix, returns correct sheets/rows/cols/row_count, returns 400 on empty/invalid file, and requires admin auth. POST /api/wyceny/{id}/import/apply requires admin, returns 404 for unknown wycena, creates stages+positions with correct ordering, auto-creates default 'Etap 1' when positions precede first stage, treats skip-role and empty-name-cell as skipped, accepts optional unit_col/quantity_col/notes_col=None without crashing, parses Polish numeric format (commas + thousand spaces -> 1000.75), and appends new stages after existing ones preserving ascending order.
action_items: (Optional) The applied 'notes' value is stored on the wyceny_positions doc under key 'notes' - confirm frontend Wyceny editor surfaces it (the dialog spec mentions notes mapping; backend stores correctly).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/wyceny.py preview: properly strips data-URI prefix, validates base64, catches openpyxl load errors with HTTP 400. Limits to 500x30 cells - good safeguard against huge files.
routes/wyceny.py apply: order preservation via sorted(rows, key=row_index) and per-stage current_stage_id tracking is correct. Auto-default 'Etap 1' creation when positions precede first stage works.
to_float() handles Polish format ('12,5', '1 000,75') via space-strip + comma-to-dot, with regex fallback for embedded numerics - robust.
Optional cols (unit_col / quantity_col / notes_col) all guarded with 'is not None' before cell lookup - confirmed no crash when None.
Apply correctly continues numbering when wycena already has stages (count_documents seeds stage_order/pos_order).
seed_data_creation: Each test creates a TEST_iter95v_<uuid> wycena via POST /api/wyceny and deletes it in fixture teardown (DELETE /api/wyceny/{id}). No residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: cd /app && export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL frontend/.env|cut -d= -f2-) && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iter95v_wyceny_excel_import.py -v. Note: the GET endpoint to inspect resulting structure is /api/wyceny/{id}/template (not /full) - returns {wycena, stages:[{positions:[...]}]}. Frontend testing not performed (request was backend-only); ExcelImportDialog testids per spec exist in /app/frontend/src/components/wyceny/ExcelImportDialog.js.
